settings.editor: Earn points toward scholarship eligibility by referring new members to SDI Travel Trust.

Purpose

Members can help expand the SDI Travel Trust community while earning points toward travel scholarship opportunities. Members receive 30 points for each eligible new member referral.

Eligibility

Active SDI Travel Trust members in good standing are eligible to submit referrals. Referred individuals must not already be members and must not have been previously referred by the same member.

Points may qualify for the following scholarship levels:

  • 300 points: up to $3,000 scholarship eligibility
  • 600 points: up to $6,000 scholarship eligibility
  • 900 points: up to $9,000 scholarship eligibility
  • 1,200 points: up to $12,000 scholarship eligibility

Scholarships are subject to program eligibility, verification, application requirements, available funding, and official terms and conditions.
Log in to your Member Portal and open the Refer tab.
Submit the referred person's name and email address.
An administrator reviews the referral for eligibility.
Once approved, 30 points are added to your account automatically.
Participation in this program is subject to official SDI Travel Trust program terms, eligibility verification, and applicable law. Read the full terms.
